provenance.phaseConvention: First geometry: largest AO coefficient positive. Scan: maximum one-to-one cross-AO overlap within occupied/virtual blocks, positive matched overlap. No interpolation.

systems.name: Allyl radical · C₃H₅
systems.geometryKind: fixed manually specified model geometry; not optimized or measured

orbitals.name: SOMO (open-shell ROHF)
orbitals.description: A spin-adapted open-shell doublet with a singly occupied molecular orbital. The central carbon is near a SOMO node. ROHF constrains doubly occupied alpha/beta spatial orbitals to coincide; it omits UHF spin polarization.

orbitals.name: Spin density ρα − ρβ
orbitals.description: Signed ROHF spin density from alpha minus beta occupied densities. It equals the SOMO density in this one-unpaired-electron model; beta-excess polarization is absent by construction. Teal is alpha excess; amber would be beta excess. This is a density, not orbital phase; it cannot be phase reversed.

orbitals.name: π1
orbitals.description: Canonical RHF π orbital, MO 17, B1u symmetry in the computational subgroup. The six-carbon π system is delocalized. Degenerate pairs allow arbitrary orthogonal combinations; an individual partner is not a unique observable. Orbitals alone do not measure aromatic stabilization or establish a reaction pathway.

systems.geometryKind: fixed manually specified model geometry; not optimized or measured

orbitals.name: π1
orbitals.description: Canonical RHF π orbital, MO 14, Au symmetry in the computational subgroup. The four π orbitals have progressively increasing nodal structure (π1: 0 longitudinal nodes in the ideal conjugated-chain interpretation, plus the molecular plane). This s-trans geometry must reorganize to s-cis for Diels–Alder; no transition state is computed.
